name: receipt-for-another-demand
invariant: A receipt for another demand does not apply, whatever its conclusions: two gate results on the same tree with the same predicate conclusions hold receipts for demands A and B. For demand B, B's resolves and A's is missing, evidence_inapplicable; the evaluator does not claim the review of A's gate for demand B (the lease half); and a review claimed for demand A does not commit once demand B is required, evidence_inapplicable (the commit half, 13 [G4]) (06 rule 6; 11 intake).
